name: WinMain
notes: called from CRT startup with hInstance=0x400000; calls SetUnhandledExceptionFilter + RegisterClassExA wrapper + Com_Init

name: Com_Init
notes: only caller of 0x0082CD10; called from WinMain (calls.csv)

name: Com_Init_Try_Block_Function
notes: references "--- Common Initialization Complete ---"; calls CL_Init and Steam init

name: Com_ExecStartupConfigs
notes: references "exec default.cfg"; name by analogy with IW engine

name: Hunk_AllocAlign
notes: references its own error string "Hunk_AllocAlign failed on %i bytes"; also calls VirtualAlloc

name: Steam_Init
notes: calls SteamAPI_Init + SteamAPI_RestartAppIfNecessary + SteamUtils; called from Com_Init_Try_Block_Function. Engine name unknown

name: Sys_RegisterWindowClass
notes: only RegisterClassExA site; called from WinMain. Engine name unknown

name: R_InitThenPresent_caller
notes: calls R_Init and 0x006EB1F0; render-thread entry or CL_InitRenderer — resolve in P1

name: R_CreateWindow
notes: CreateWindowExA site next to the D3D init code

name: R_InitRenderResources
notes: references "Initializing render targets..." / "dynamic buffers..." / "static model cache..."

name: R_PresentAndPumpMessages
notes: references "Direct3DDevice9::Present failed: %s (%d)"; contains PeekMessageA/GetMessageA/DispatchMessageA. Frame-end anchor (R_EndFrame equivalent). Engine name unknown

name: R_LockVertexBuffer
notes: references "DirectX didn't lock a vertex buffer: %s"

name: Material_CompileShader
notes: only D3DXCompileShader call site; references "%s compilation failed - NULL shader"; callers 0x00701A40 / 0x00701B40

name: Material_CopyTextToDXBuffer
notes: D3DXCreateBuffer site; name taken from its own error string

name: DB_LoadXFile
notes: compares fastfile magic "IWffu100"/"IWff0100"; references "Loading fastfile '%s'"; single caller 0x00580E60

name: Bink_InitPlayback
notes: BinkSetSoundSystem / BinkOpenDirectSound / BinkRegisterFrameBuffers / BinkSetMemory site. Engine name unknown

name: Bink_UpdateFrame
notes: BinkDoFrame / BinkNextFrame / BinkWait / BinkShouldSkip site; no direct callers (called through a pointer)

name: SND_InitDriver
notes: only caller of both CoCreateInstance sites

name: SND_CreateXAudio2
notes: CoInitializeEx + CoCreateInstance site; XAudio2 RTTI present in exe — CLSID not yet read

name: SND_CoCreate_B
notes: second CoCreateInstance site; same caller as 0x008B17E0

name: Voice_InitDirectSound
notes: DSOUND #11 site; references "ERROR: [play] failed to initialize DirectSound"
